idea_sources: Gemini Deep Research report (2026-10-10) used as idea source only ('Ideengeber'), not as a scientific source; see docs/v02_benchmarks.md and FAKTENCHECK.

H2.model: temporal ETAS, piecewise-constant yearly background mu_y, common (K, alpha, c, p)
H2.estimator: two-stage: (1) stationary ETAS on the fit window -> triggering parameters; (2) yearly log mu_y with triggering parameters fixed (etas_nonstat.fit_two_stage)
H2.events: all events >= v0.1.0 reference Mc (not declustered), v0.1.0 catalogues/regions
H2.se_rule: SE = max(OLS residual SE, likelihood SE) * se_calibration_factor
H2.se_calibration_basis: null simulations (48 stationary synthetic catalogues): sd(z) = 1.11 (slope), 1.18 (window log-ratio); 90 % bootstrap upper bound ~1.25

H2_1.statistic: OLS slope of log mu_y over 1995-2025 per decade; DiD glacier - control
H2_1.multiplicity: Benjamini-Hochberg q = 0.05 over the three pairs

H2_2.statistic: mu ratio 2020-2025 vs 2008-2019 from yearly log mu (Welch SE x factor) and total-rate ratio of all events >= Mc in the same windows
H2_2.interpretation: descriptive classification, no p-value; a 'masked' class in a glacier region counts only if its network-internal control is not also 'masked'

H3.tide: degree-2 body tide (Moon + Sun), areal strain (2h-6l) W2/(g a), h=0.6114, l=0.0832; NO ocean loading
H3.phase: Tanaka et al. 2002: 0 deg at strain maximum, +/-180 at minima, linear in time

H3_2.test: b(|phase|<90) < b(|phase|>=90), one-sided z (Shi-Bolt SE); LR test reported

H3.power: simulation MDE of modulation amplitude a (rate ~ 1 + a cos phase) and Delta b at alpha 0.05, power 0.8

C2.statistic: D = [log mu_new - log mu_ref]_glacier - [log mu_new - log mu_ref]_control; mu_new = constant-mu MLE on [2027-01-01, look end] with frozen triggering parameters (etas_nonstat.mu_window_mle), events from the previous tmax as history only
C2.se: sqrt(sum over both regions of se_new^2 + sigma_year^2 / T_window + sigma_year^2 / n_ref_years)
C2.baselines_file: results/frozen_v02_baselines.json (computed from data to 2025-12-31, frozen and hashed before 2027-01-01)
C2.catalogue_rules: same sources, region boxes, depth filters and Mc as v0.1.0; magnitudes as reported at the time of the look
C2.relation_to_C1: independent of C1 (v0.1.0); C1 is unchanged

monitoring.M6_background_rise: one-sided z = (log mu_new - log mu_ref)/se for a glacier region alone >= 2.0 -> flag (no control, monitoring only)
monitoring.M7_tidal_schuster: Schuster p < 0.01 on declustered events (frozen v0.1 NN threshold) in the new window for a test region with N >= 200 -> flag

change_rules: Any change after freezing is a new, dated addendum with a new hash; the original file stays in git history.
